description: Electric Vehicle Charging Points is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. Calderdale Council, West Yorkshire Combined Authority, Bradford, Leeds, Kirklees and Wakefield Councils collaborated with Engie to install 88 rapid charging points for electric vehicles across West Yorkshire. A map of Calderdale's current charging points is available here. Coverage: Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal files it under the publisher Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
